notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076481/3b1cc8ff62bdd4975b6bc2e6854827db902f126e.jpg
v1.0.4

Dear RocketInc players,

We have come with many innovations for you. This patch was made taking into account your wishes and suggestions. Please read the notes below carefully. You need to create a new game to play the newly added mission types. Thank you for your understanding.

Latest Changes:

What's New

Passive Income System

Every 10 seconds you will earn landing platform count x 2.

Cargo Ship

A cargo ship coming from outside into our solar system proceeds on a certain path. During this time, the missions to be taken over it will earn more money and reputation.

Pirate Rocket

There are now pirate zones at certain points on the map. If you are caught passing through these areas, your fuel and heal will be taken by the pirate rocket.

Rescue Missions

Help different rockets that are stuck somewhere in the solar system by carrying fuel.

Station Missions

Get people there to develop stations.

Cargo Damage Sensitive Missions

Some missions are considered unsuccessful when they fall below certain damage.

In addition, the planets now revolve around themselves. You should be more careful while landing.
